description: Ministry of Labour and Trade Union Relations - Appoint persons to be members of the  Wages Boards on Nursing Home Trade, Tea Export Trade etc.,
categorisation: This gazette exclusively lists the appointments of named individuals (Dr. Nanda Wijerathna, Mr. Nadaraja Manmada Rajan, etc.) to various Wages Boards. It provides only their names and the general title of "member" of a specific board. There is no description of their detailed responsibilities, functions, or portfolio duties, which is the key requirement for a Hybrid (Type 3) classification. The content is purely about government personnel changes.
